# Starks Global Group

> An AI-powered automation platform that helps entrepreneurs and businesses build and run automated income systems. Users select a blueprint, connect their tools, and an AI agent builds the system on their behalf.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://starksglobalgroup.net/): Platform overview and entry point
- [Blueprints](https://starksglobalgroup.net/blueprints): Pre-built AI system architectures across 6 categories — affiliate content, lead generation, automation agencies, video content, email funnels, chatbot sales, social growth, and content traffic
- [Marketplace](https://starksglobalgroup.net/marketplace): Curated directory of 43 AI and automation tools across 8 categories (Content Creation, Automation, Funnels/Marketing, SEO/Traffic, AI Tools, Business Systems)
- [Pricing](https://starksglobalgroup.net/pricing): Subscription tiers and plan comparison
- [Updates](https://starksglobalgroup.net/updates): Platform changelog and new feature announcements
- [How It Works](https://starksglobalgroup.net/how-it-works): Step-by-step walkthrough of the blueprint execution process
- [Business Model](https://starksglobalgroup.net/business-model): Overview of the platform's revenue and affiliate model
- [Research Lab](https://starksglobalgroup.net/research-lab): AI system research and insights
- [Why Trust Us](https://starksglobalgroup.net/why-trust-us): Credibility, transparency, and affiliate disclosure context
- [About](https://starksglobalgroup.net/about): Company background and mission
- [Contact](https://starksglobalgroup.net/contact): Support and inquiry contact page
